note: Both sets capture the same core details (14/16 gauge plates, #10 TEK screws, HSS4X4X1/4, W6X20, 28" footing, 6" min/max opening dims) and share the same flaws: the bolt quote fabricates a '3"' that appears only as a separate dimension, the (4) 3/4" holes are bound to a deck opening plate although they sit in the foundation detail, and 1'-0" is labeled MIN in the text layer but reported as the opening's maximum. B additionally binds the 3" std pipe and PL5x4x3/8 to the PV attachment detail (A1), where they actually appear, whereas A leaves them as vague generic 'pipe' and 'plate' claims that collide with its separate PL5X3/8 plate claim. B is therefore slightly more faithful in component binding with no additional errors.
